profile.summary: csnover is a **senior JavaScript developer** with deep expertise in **jQuery core development**, specializing in **bug fixes, cross-browser compatibility, and testing**. Their contributions focus on **legacy browser support (particularly IE7)**, **DOM manipulation**, **AJAX robustness**, and **performance optimizations**. The developer demonstrates **advanced debugging skills**, **defensive programming**, and **test suite maintenance**, with a strong emphasis on **stability and edge-case handling**. While primarily a **frontend specialist**, their work reflects a **laser focus on jQuery internals** and **real-world browser quirks** rather than modern frameworks or backend systems.

Asynchronous Programming: Memory leak cleanup in async ops
